thesis: 가장 강한 공매도 논리는 '좋은 광고 사업'이 아니라 '자본집약적 AI 인프라 기업으로의 구조 변화'다. $741.25는 Base 가치 $638보다 약 16% 높고, AI·리스 약정이 급증한 반면 Q2 FCF는 거의 0이었다. Reality Labs·규제·창업자 지배까지 겹치면 큰 가격 하락은 가능하다. 그러나 현재 증거는 회계 신뢰성 훼손, 생존용 외부자본 의존, 고객가치 부재, 지속적 해자 축소, Bull 초과 가격 등 Hard Veto의 구성요건을 충족하지 않는다.

evidence.claim: At the frozen price $741.25, deterministic Base value is about $638.42 and Bull value about $1,090.61; price/Base is 1.1611x.
At June 30, 2026 Meta reported $349.31B of non-cancelable contractual commitments and $278.99B of uncommenced lease obligations, while Q2 company-defined FCF was only $0.784B after $31.08B of capex.
The same Q2 filing shows $90.26B cash and marketable securities, about $84B notes and H1 OCF of $64.09B, contradicting a near-term solvency or survival-funding thesis.
Q2 2026 ad impressions rose 14% and average price per ad rose 12%; measured AI ranking tests also reported positive click/conversion lifts, contradicting growth without customer value.
Family DAP reached 3.60B in Q2 2026, up 3% YoY, while ad price and impressions also increased; observable moat indicators do not show persistent shrinkage.
The 2026 proxy reports Mark Zuckerberg with about 60.8% total voting power, limiting minority-shareholder corrective influence if large AI or Reality Labs capital-allocation bets disappoint.

counterevidence: Measured advertiser ROI, user scale and rising ad pricing argue that the core franchise is not deteriorating today.
Liquidity and OCF remain strong enough that infrastructure financing is not currently a survival necessity.
Bull intrinsic value remains well above the frozen price, so valuation is demanding versus Base but not Bull-plus.
Net diluted shares declined YoY, so high SBC has not translated into persistent net share-count expansion in the latest period.
unknowns: The maintenance-like versus growth portion of 2026-30 AI infrastructure spending remains undisclosed.
The realized incremental ROIC on the $100B+ annual infrastructure buildout cannot yet be measured directly.
falsifiers: AI infrastructure produces sustained owner-FCF/share recovery while ad monetization remains double-digit, defeating the capital-intensity short thesis.
Business messaging/agents or wearables become material high-margin profit pools, reducing advertising concentration.
Reality Labs losses stabilize or decline while meaningful recurring revenue emerges.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No reviewed filing/proxy evidence establishes a restatement, auditor disagreement/change, material control failure, or undisclosed related-party event; the required integrity-breach element is not met.
H1 OCF was $64.09B and the core business funds itself; recent debt supports accelerated discretionary infrastructure rather than a business unable to operate without repeated external financing.
Rising ad prices and impressions plus measured click/conversion gains directly evidence advertiser value; the mandatory absence-of-customer-value element is false.
Full AI incremental ROIC is unverified, but below-cost incremental ROIC and structural persistence are not established; uncertainty is not a confirmed collapse.
DAP, ad impressions and ad pricing were maintained or improving through Q2 2026, so actual and persistent moat shrinkage is not established.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: $741.25 is below the deterministic Bull value of about $1,090.61, so the sole veto element is false.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Advertising concentration is high, but demand is distributed across many advertisers, apps and jurisdictions; no single customer/product/regulatory loss is evidenced as causing unrecoverable business economics.

next_checks: Re-run the short thesis after Q3/FY2026 capex, OCF and 2027 infrastructure guidance.
Check for any accounting-control/auditor developments and updated legal contingencies.
Reprice the Bull-veto and expectation gap after any >15% share-price move or EV scenario revision.

uncertainties.rationale: The bull case depends on a return profile for AI infrastructure that is not yet directly observable.
Substantially all revenue still comes from advertising even though no single customer or regulation is currently fatal.
